events.title: BlackBerry Z10 released
events.summary: BlackBerry released the BlackBerry Z10 — first BlackBerry 10 full-touch flagship — post-iPhone reboot attempt.
events.about: BlackBerry dominated enterprise mobile before iPhone and Android. First blackberry 10 full-touch flagship — post-iphone reboot attempt. BES-connected apps and push email defined mobile workflows for years.

narrative.whyChosen: The BlackBerry Z10 was a key BlackBerry hardware milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: BlackBerry hardware set expectations for mobile email and messaging security.
narrative.problemSolved: Business users needed secure mobile email before modern smartphone platforms.
